references.text: The daughters of Hepher, including Zelophehad, are mentioned here as descendants of Hepher from the tribe of Manasseh, showing the continuation of the lineage from Numbers 26:32.
Zelophehad is mentioned as one of the sons of Manasseh who received an inheritance in the land of Canaan, confirming the lineage from Numbers 26:32.
Hepher is mentioned as the son of Gilead and the father of Zelophehad, connecting this verse with the genealogy in Numbers 26:32.
Zelophehad is listed among the descendants of Manasseh in the genealogies of Chronicles, confirming the lineage from Numbers 26:32.
Hepher is mentioned as the father of a person from an area that later became known, showing a geographical and familial connection to the Hepher clan.
